monetization.reason: No approved affiliate program or tracking ID is configured. The conversion improvement is a product-neutral payment-and-receipt guide for a purchase-ready reader: it identifies the transaction type, exposes total fees, reconciles licensed seller/product/tax/tender records, protects payment and loyalty data, and preserves an error packet. No merchant, payment provider, product, price, discount, rating, stock claim, fabricated test, cannabis sale, product image, or affiliate link was added; cancellation, another tender, or no purchase remains a valid outcome.

image_qa.note: Both new guides and the Santiam profile use text, tables, checklists, and existing interface assets. The Santiam page explicitly withholds a cultivar photograph because the USDA accession has no image and no exact licensed image was verified. No person, apartment, smoke plume, cannabis product, terminal, receipt, payment-provider logo, merchant, product image, stock image, or generated image was added or changed.

search_console.decision: The October 19–November 15 report is two days old and valid: 830 impressions, three clicks, 0.36% CTR, and average position 20.69. Arkansas at ten impressions and position 10.2 was already materially reinforced November 12, and Blue Dream's 48-impression family was materially reinforced November 17. The report's stale/erroring submitted sitemap records selected the technical authority action outside the three-page portfolio: publish and audit a canonical coverage/link inventory beside the live sitemap while preserving the legacy compatibility payload. The 510-versus-disposable and trimming-scissors rows had two impressions each; Delaware had two impressions and one click; the chronic-pain HTTP row had one impression. Those query/page signals were deliberately ignored as too weak, already served, or insufficient to justify another cluster variation. No new page is Data-led today; analytics protected diversity and focused crawl verification.

authority.action: Published a citation-ready shared-air resolution asset with an episode record, pathway map, source-control ladder, conversation script, cleaner/monitor claim boundaries, and current CDC, EPA, and HUD entry points. Added an evidence-first Santiam identity file that reconciles its USDA PVP application, germplasm accession, applicant-described traits, and exact-lot boundaries. Reciprocal links strengthen the secondhand-smoke and hemp identity clusters. The machine-readable coverage inventory and public policy contract strengthen trust by exposing canonical scope, dates, topics, core angles, and contextual link paths. No outreach opportunity was logged and no outreach was sent; the on-site authority and auditability work was the higher-value action.
